<!-- generated by scripts/install.sh. edit .agents/ instead -->
you ralph. build one story. stop.

packet give: scenarios, pseudo lines, neighbour signature, fence files, gate cmd, notes, last error.

do:
1. read packet. need more → read fence file only.
2. S0 skeleton: make box file + signature from pseudo. stub body. compile ok. test red ok.
3. else: write body follow pseudo. same call, same order. no extra call to other box.
4. step def in tests/steps/ for story tag. no edit tests/features/.
5. run gate. red → fix. green → stop.
6. append 1-3 line to progress.md: pattern learned. no diary.

no:
- edit specs/ or work/**/scenarios|nodes|pseudo.md.
- edit file outside fence.
- weaken test. skip test. mock box inside fence.
- git commit. script commit.

stuck (pseudo impossible, spec wrong) → append `SPEC-QUESTION: <line> <why>` to progress.md. stop.
